notes: The construction-supplied dummy subject and copula 'it is' were placed on מֵאֵת, the preposition heading an adjunct phrase, under rule 49. Rule 49 governs a preposition that is itself the clause's predicate, and here the predicate is the construct nominal בְּרִית עוֹלָם; the ASV fronts the adjunct so that the copula falls beside it, which rule 20 expressly says is not what decides the placement. LEV.24.3 aligns the same construction the other way, giving 'it shall be' to חֻקַּת, so the chapter analysed one construction two ways.
